Class GenomicRun

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.genomics.GenomicRun
All Implemented Interfaces:
Indexable<AlignedRead>, Run, Streamable<AlignedRead>, AutoCloseable
public class GenomicRun extends Object implements Indexable<AlignedRead>, Streamable<AlignedRead>, Run, AutoCloseable
Lazy view over one /study/genomic_runs/<name>/ group.

Materialises AlignedRead objects on demand from the signal channels. The GenomicIndex is loaded eagerly at open time for cheap filtering and offset lookups; the heavy signal channels (sequences, qualities, plus 3 compounds) stay lazy.

Genomic analogue of AcquisitionRun.

API status: Stable ().

Cross-language equivalents: Objective-C TTIOGenomicRun, Python ttio.genomic_run.GenomicRun.

    • provenanceChain

      public List<ProvenanceRecord> provenanceChain()
      Phase 1 (post-M91): per-run provenance chain in insertion order. Closes the M91 read-side gap — until Phase 1 the lazy GenomicRun view didn't expose provenance, so cross- modality queries had to fall back to the @sample_name attribute. Returns an empty list for runs that carry no provenance.

      Source of record: the provenance_json attribute on the /study/genomic_runs/<name>/ group, written by SpectralDataset.writeGenomicRunSubtree(StorageGroup, String, WrittenGenomicRun) (Phase 1) — same on-disk pattern as AcquisitionRun.writeProvenance(StorageGroup).

      Specified by:
      provenanceChain in interface Run

    • readNameAt

      public String readNameAt(int i)
      return the read name at index i.

      Only the NAME_TOKENIZED_V2 (codec id 15) layout is supported in v1.0+. Legacy v1 layouts raise IllegalStateException:

      • flat uint8 + @compression == NAME_TOKENIZED (8) → v1 codec rejected, see message.
      • VL-string compound dataset (layout) → also rejected; the v1.0 writer produces flat uint8 v2 only.

      If readCount == 0 the writer emits an empty group (no child datasets); this method short-circuits there.

    • cigarAt

      public String cigarAt(int i)
      return the cigar string at index i, dispatching on dataset shape (Binding Decisions §120-§123).

      Two on-disk layouts:

      • M82 compound (no override): VL_STRING-in-compound dataset, read whole-and-cache via compoundRows(String).
      • rANS codec (override active): flat 1-D uint8 dataset. The whole channel is read, decoded once, and cached as a List<String> on this instance per . The decoded byte buffer is a length-prefix-concat sequence (varint(len) + bytes per CIGAR); walk the buffer to reconstruct the list.

    • mateChromAt

      public String mateChromAt(int i)
      return the mate chromosome at index i. Only the inline_v2 blob layout is supported now; the M86 Phase F per-field subgroup and the M82 compound layout raise IllegalStateException.

    • sequencesFull

      public byte[] sequencesFull()
      Return the full ``signal_channels/sequences`` byte array. Side-effect: populates the per-channel cache so that subsequent per-record byteChannelSlice(String, long, int) calls slice the warm buffer instead of issuing fresh HDF5 reads. This matters for uncompressed channels, which the codec path does not cache automatically.

    • qualitiesFull

      public byte[] qualitiesFull()
      Return the full ``signal_channels/qualities`` byte array. Same warm-cache semantics as sequencesFull().

    • readNamesAll

      public List<String> readNamesAll()
      Return the full read-names list, forcing the one-shot NAME_TOKENIZED_V2 decode + cache. Mirrors the Python ``GenomicRun._read_name_at`` cache priming idiom.
